### App — Auto-Backup Fixes — 2026-06-07

- **fix: Auto-backup worker never ran** — `_auto_backup_worker` called `db()` which uses `current_app.config`, a Flask request-context proxy unavailable in background threads. Every 5-minute tick threw `RuntimeError`, silently swallowed by `except Exception: pass`. Fixed via new `_get_db_path_for_worker()` that imports `web.server` lazily and reads `app.config['DB_PATH']` directly. (`web/routes/backup.py`)
- **fix: Auto-backup skipped missing directory** — worker checked `os.path.isdir(bdir)` and silently skipped if the folder didn't exist yet. Now calls `os.makedirs(bdir, exist_ok=True)` before the check, matching the behaviour of the manual backup route. (`web/routes/backup.py`)
- **fix: Stale-backup warning suppressed when auto-backup enabled** — `warn` was computed as `not auto_on and age_days > 7`, so a broken or newly-enabled auto-backup never triggered the warning. Changed to `age_days > 7` unconditionally. (`web/routes/backup.py`)
- **fix: Backup status and list sorted alphabetically instead of by date** — `_backup_` files ranked above `_auto_` files regardless of actual modification time, causing the status endpoint to report a stale manual backup as the most recent file even when a fresh auto backup existed. Fixed all three sort calls (status, list, worker interval check) to use `key=os.path.getmtime`. (`web/routes/backup.py`)

### Build — Release Notes in Update Ribbon — 2026-06-07

- **feat: Release notes in update banner** — the Notes button on the update ribbon now shows meaningful content. `build_dist.py` extracts the first CHANGELOG.md block (Unreleased or latest version) during the build, previews it interactively, writes it to `RELEASE_NOTES.txt` (shipped in the dist zip), and stores it as `version.json["notes"]` in dbox-releases. The dashboard modal gains `max-height:60vh; overflow-y:auto` so long notes scroll rather than overflow the viewport. (`tools/build_dist.py`, `web/templates/dashboard.html`)

### App — EOFY Rollover — 2026-06-07

- **feat: EOFY Rollover wizard** — Settings → Wizards → EOFY Rollover. Posts year-end closing journal entries (DR income accounts, CR expense accounts, net to Retained Earnings 3-1300) dated the last day of the FY, then sets a lock date on the company record. Stat cards show FY date range, total income, and net profit/YTD. Status banner reflects: in progress / ready to close / closed. (`core/ledger.py`, `web/routes/company.py`, `web/static/js/settings.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: Period lock for manual journals** — after rollover, `POST /api/journal` rejects any entry dated on or before the lock date with a clear error message directing the user to post a correcting entry in the current period. Existing transactions in the new FY are unaffected. (`web/routes/journal.py`, `core/database.py`)
- **fix: EOFY status page now advances to current running FY after rollover** — `eofy_status()` previously returned the last completed FY even when already rolled, leaving the UI stuck. Now detects `already_rolled=True` and advances to the currently running FY (e.g., shows FY2026 in progress after FY2025 is closed). (`core/ledger.py`)
- **fix: Section reloads after rollover** — after a successful rollover the page reloads automatically (800ms) so the user sees the new current FY rather than a stale "Roll Over" button. Previous-lock banner confirms what was closed and reassures that new-FY transactions are unaffected. (`web/static/js/settings.js`)
- **feat: EOFY pre-flight checklist** — before rolling over, the page shows a three-item checklist: outstanding AR (unpaid invoices dated in the FY), outstanding AP (unpaid bills dated in the FY), and unreconciled bank transactions. Each warning item links directly to the relevant module (Invoices, Bills, Bank Rec). Checks are informational — not blockers — with a note to that effect. (`core/ledger.py`, `web/static/js/settings.js`)
- **feat: Accountant package download from EOFY page** — a "Download FY20XX Package" button appears below the rollover button at all times once a FY has completed. Hits the existing `/api/reports/eoy-package` endpoint with the correct date range pre-filled (TB CSV + GL CSV + FA schedule in a ZIP). `pkg_fy` field added to `eofy_status()` response to always track the most recently completed FY independently of the rollover advance logic. (`core/ledger.py`, `web/static/js/settings.js`)

### Website & App — Favicon — 2026-06-07

- **feat: Favicon** — new `favicon.svg` using the icon-mark (dog head, ears, eyes, nose centred in a navy rounded-square, viewBox tuned for 16–512px tab sizes). All four website pages and the app's `dashboard.html` updated to reference the new file; previously all pointed at the full multi-variant `dogbox_logo.svg` which rendered all four logo variants stacked and looked broken. (`dbox-website/static/img/favicon.svg`, `web/static/favicon.svg`, `web/templates/dashboard.html`)
- **fix: Deploy script now includes privacy.html and terms.html** — those pages were never deployed via `deploy.sh`, only `index.html` and `contact.html` were copied. (`dbox-website/deploy/deploy.sh`)

### Infrastructure — 2026-06-07

- **chore: DNS incident resolved** — `dogboxsoftware.com.au` was serving ad-injection content from a third-party server (27.124.125.171) via two stale proxied Cloudflare A records, likely created during initial site setup when that IP was dormant. Deleted the rogue records; confirmed single proxied A record → 134.199.175.3 (DigitalOcean droplet). `demo` and `license` subdomains confirmed DNS-only (correct — Certbot handles SSL directly). Google 2FA enabled on Cloudflare SSO account. Demo site unaffected throughout.

### Codebase Refactor — Audit 2026 (branch: refactor/audit-2026)

- **refactor: Remove ui/ import from core/invoice_pdf.py** — `try/except from ui.shared import load_theme` block removed. One-way dependency rule now enforced; `_resolve_theme(None)` already falls back to `DEFAULT_DOC_THEME`. (`core/invoice_pdf.py`)
- **refactor: Standardise purchase_orders.py response envelopes** — 6 routes using raw `jsonify()` converted to `ok()`/`err()`. JS callers updated to read `d.data?.po_id`, `d.data?.status`. (`web/routes/purchase_orders.py`, `web/static/js/purchase_orders.js`)
- **refactor: Centralise company column migrations** — inline `ALTER TABLE company ADD COLUMN` try/except blocks removed from both `api_company()` and `api_company_save()`. All columns guaranteed by `core/database._migrate()` at startup. (`web/routes/company.py`, `core/database.py`)
- **refactor: Extract admin diagnostic logic to core/** — `diagnose_balances()`, `repair_opening_balances()`, `repair_date_formats()` moved from inline route SQL to `core/admin_tools.py`. Routes reduced to thin wrappers. (`core/admin_tools.py`, `web/routes/admin.py`)
- **refactor: Extract bill stock receipt logic to core/** — `receive_bill_stock(db_path, bill_id, lines, ...)` added to `core/inventory.py`. Route reduced from ~65 lines to ~20. (`core/inventory.py`, `web/routes/bills.py`)
- **refactor: Move user/auth functions from budget.py to core/auth.py** — `_hash_password`, `verify_password`, `authenticate_user`, `ensure_default_admin`, `get_users`, `get_user`, `create_user`, `update_user`, `set_own_password` all moved. `budget.py` re-exports for backward compat. Import sites updated. (`core/auth.py`, `core/budget.py`, `web/routes/auth.py`, `web/routes/users.py`, `web/routes/startup.py`)
- **refactor: Consolidate PDF watermark canvas** — `_make_watermark_canvas()` moved to `core/invoice_pdf.py` as canonical location. `reports_pdf.py` imports from there. Unused `_make_watermark_callback` import removed from `quote_pdf.py`, `payment_pdf.py`, `job_card_pdf.py`. (`core/invoice_pdf.py`, `core/reports_pdf.py`, `core/quote_pdf.py`, `core/payment_pdf.py`, `core/job_card_pdf.py`)
- **refactor: Remove local _esc() duplicates from 4 JS modules** — local `function _esc(s)` definitions deleted from `bankrec.js`, `help.js`, `purchase_orders.js`, `users.js`. All `_esc()` calls replaced with global `esc()`. (`web/static/js/bankrec.js`, `web/static/js/help.js`, `web/static/js/purchase_orders.js`, `web/static/js/users.js`)
- **refactor: Remove local date formatter duplicates from 2 JS modules** — `_fmtDate()` removed from `purchase_orders.js`, `_fmtDateDisplay()` removed from `bills.js`. Calls replaced with global `fmtDate()`. (`web/static/js/purchase_orders.js`, `web/static/js/bills.js`)
- **refactor: Replace payroll.js private API wrapper** — `_pApi()`/`_pGet` stub removed. `_pGet` calls (88 occurrences) replaced with `apiFetch()`. `_pPost/_pPut/_pDel` now delegate to new `_pMut()` which uses raw `fetch()` and unwraps the `ok/data` envelope. (`web/static/js/payroll.js`)
- **feat: createModal() global helper in dashboard.html** — shared modal factory `createModal({ width, maxHeight, html, onClose })` added to global script block. Replaces ad-hoc copy-paste of `modal-bd`/`modal-box` construction across modules. (`web/templates/dashboard.html`)
- **refactor: Externalise hardcoded brand URL** — `DBOX_SUPPORT_URL` constant injected from Flask config via `{{ support_url|default(...) }}`. Update-available banner uses the constant instead of a hardcoded string. (`web/templates/dashboard.html`)
- **feat: CSS .hidden utility class** — `.hidden { display: none; }` added to `dbox.css` for class-based initial hide pattern. (`web/static/dbox.css`)
- **refactor: CSS hex colours → CSS variables** — 26 class definitions converted from hardcoded hex to CSS variable tokens. New tokens added to `:root`: `--teal`, `--teal-dim`, `--purple`, `--purple-dim`, `--muted-dim`. (`web/static/dbox.css`)

### Licensing — PDF Branding Footer

- **feat: PDF branding footer shown on all tiers** — "Created with Dogbox Accounting · dogboxsoftware.com.au" now appears on PDFs for all users (Free and Pro) by default. Previously it was only shown for Free-tier users after the FREE_UNTIL grace period. (`core/licence.py`)
- **feat: Pro users can disable PDF branding footer in Settings** — Company Details section now includes a "Show Dogbox branding footer on PDFs" checkbox. Disabled with an "(always on in Free)" note for Free-tier users. Setting stored in `company.pdf_branding` (INTEGER DEFAULT 1). (`core/database.py`, `web/routes/company.py`, `web/static/js/settings.js`)
- **refactor: Consolidated duplicate PDF helper functions** — `_get_pdf_watermark` and `_get_pdf_footer` were defined identically in four route files (`jobs.py`, `contacts.py`, `reports.py`, `payroll.py`). Removed local copies; all files now import from `web.shared`. (`web/routes/jobs.py`, `web/routes/contacts.py`, `web/routes/reports.py`, `web/routes/payroll.py`)
- **refactor: `_get_combined_pdf_footer(db_path)` in `web/shared.py`** — new helper returns the maintenance-lapse footer (amber, priority) or the branding footer (grey). All PDF routes updated to call this instead of `_get_pdf_footer()`. (`web/shared.py`, `web/routes/invoices.py`, `web/routes/bills.py`, `web/routes/fixed_assets.py`, `web/routes/jobs.py`, `web/routes/contacts.py`, `web/routes/reports.py`, `web/routes/payroll.py`)
- **fix: PDF branding footer colour changed from amber to accent blue (#185FA5)** — amber was the maintenance-lapse warning colour; branding footer is informational so uses the app's standard accent blue. (`core/invoice_pdf.py`, `core/reports_pdf.py`)
- **fix: Overdue email PDF now respects branding setting** — `email_invoice.py` previously only applied the maintenance-lapse footer to the overdue notice PDF. Updated to apply the combined footer logic inline (reads `company.pdf_branding` from the DB directly, as `core/` cannot import from `web/`). (`core/email_invoice.py`)

### App — Contacts & Jobs (Work Tasks)

- **feat: Recurring work tasks** — tasks can now be flagged as recurring with an optional frequency (Weekly, Fortnightly, Monthly, Quarterly, Annual) and due date. On completion a "Schedule next task?" modal prompts the user to create the next occurrence, with editable frequency and pre-calculated due date. The next task is created as a new recurring instance, continuing the chain. (`core/jobs.py`, `web/routes/contacts.py`, `web/static/js/contacts.js`, `web/static/js/jobs.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **fix: Edit task button in contacts crashed with `_wtOpps is not defined`** — the "CRM Opportunity" dropdown in the work task edit modal referenced `_wtOpps`, a variable that was never declared (removed in a prior session). Removed the `oppOpts` line, the opportunity `<select>` from the modal, and `opp_id` from the save payload. (`web/static/js/contacts.js`)
- **fix: 415 Unsupported Media Type on task complete toggle** — `GET /api/work-tasks/<id>/complete` returned 415 because `request.get_json()` was rejecting the request before the route body ran. Changed to `get_json(force=True, silent=True)` to accept the request regardless of Content-Type negotiation. (`web/routes/contacts.py`)
- **feat: Edit button for work tasks in Jobs** — work tasks in the Jobs Tasks tab previously had no edit button (only CRM tasks did). Added Edit button for non-invoiced work tasks, a `_jobEditWorkTask()` modal with title/description/qty/unit price/job/date fields, and `_jobSaveWorkTask()` to persist via `PUT /api/work-tasks/<id>`. The job dropdown is populated from `_jobAll` to support reassigning a task to a different job. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **fix: Work task edit modal stuck on "Saving…" after save** — `document.querySelector('.modal-bd')?.remove()` searched from the document root and could match a stale element or miss entirely. Changed to `btn.closest('.modal-bd')?.remove()` in `_jobSaveWorkTask`, `_jobDoCreatePO`, and `_jobTimeSave` — all three async save handlers that previously used the fragile querySelector pattern. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`)

### App — Contacts

- **feat: Tasks tab converted to maintenance log** — replaced the grouped card view (open/completed/invoiced sections) with a filterable table showing Task, Job, Entered date, Completed date, Notes, and Status. Filters: status pills (All/Open/Completed/Invoiced) and entered-date range. Invoice button for completed tasks retained below the table. Add-task form unchanged. (`web/static/js/contacts.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **refactor: Removed worksheet PDF from Contacts** — the field-work worksheet (sign-off blocks, materials table) was not fit-for-purpose at the contact level; the maintenance log replaces it. Worksheet remains in Jobs. (`web/routes/contacts.py`, `web/static/js/contacts.js`)

### App — Jobs & Contacts

- **fix: "Convert to Billable" modal now pre-selects the job's primary contact** — `_jobDetail?.contact_id` was always `undefined` because the job detail API nests the job under `{job: {...}}`, so the modal defaulted to blank and required manual selection. Fixed to `_jobDetail?.job?.contact_id`. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **fix: Invoice from jobs now covers opp_id-linked work tasks** — `invoice_job_work_tasks` only filtered by `job_id`, so work tasks added via the "opportunity" dropdown in contacts (which sets `opp_id` not `job_id`) appeared in the job's claims view but couldn't be invoiced there. Fixed the SELECT to `(job_id=? OR opp_id=?)`. (`core/jobs.py`)
- **fix: Work task job link uses job_id when opp is selected from contacts** — in the contacts add-task form, selecting from the "opportunity" dropdown set `opp_id` without `job_id`, causing tasks to appear in the job view but not get invoiced. Now `job_id` falls back to `oppId` when the job dropdown is empty. (`web/static/js/contacts.js`)
- **refactor: Removed opportunity dropdown from contacts task add form** — jobs and opportunities are the same table; the second dropdown was redundant, confusing, and the root cause of the `opp_id`/`job_id` mismatch bug. Removed the select, `_wtOpps` variable, and the `/api/crm/opportunities` fetch from `_loadWorkTasks`. (`web/static/js/contacts.js`)

### App — Jobs

- **fix: Cancel buttons in job sub-forms now work** — cancel on Add Comm, Add/Edit Task, New Claim, and New Quote (create mode) forms called `_jobTab('tabname')` which targets `#job-tab-content`, but sub-forms replace the entire `det-body` so that element doesn't exist. Changed to `_jobRenderDetail()` which rebuilds the panel structure first. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **fix: Invoice creation from jobs now opens the edit form** — `_jobConvertClaim`, `_jobInvoiceTasks`, `_jobConvertQuote`, and `_jobInvoiceExpenses` all navigated to the invoice detail view (read-only) after server-side creation. Changed to open `invEditOpen` with the loaded invoice data so the user sees the full edit form — contact, job, lines, and notes all pre-filled — before sending. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **fix: Default payment instructions pre-filled on invoices created from jobs** — `claim_to_invoice`, `invoice_job_work_tasks`, and `api_job_invoice_from_expenses` were creating invoices without payment instructions. Each now reads `default_payment_instructions` from the company table and includes it in the draft. (`core/jobs.py`, `web/routes/jobs.py`)
- **fix: Task Done button now sends explicit JSON body** — `_jobCompleteTask` sent a bare POST with no Content-Type; Flask's `get_json()` fell back to `True` by default but the explicit body makes behaviour consistent with the contacts toggle. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **feat: Invoice tasks from Claims tab** — the Claims tab now shows a "Billable Tasks" section listing completed, uninvoiced work tasks with an "Invoice N completed tasks" button that creates a Draft invoice against the job's primary contact. Already-invoiced tasks appear in a muted "Invoiced Tasks" sub-section with a "View Invoice" link. (`core/jobs.py`, `web/routes/jobs.py`, `web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **feat: Invoiced task status in Tasks tab** — work tasks that have been invoiced are now separated into a distinct "Invoiced (N)" section at the bottom of the Tasks tab. Each shows a "View Invoice" button. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **feat: Edit and make-billable for completed CRM tasks** — Edit and "$ Bill" buttons now appear on completed CRM tasks in the Tasks tab (not just open ones). When converting a completed task to a billable task, the new work task is automatically marked done so it immediately appears in the "Completed — awaiting invoice" queue. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **fix: Schedule calendar off by one day for Sydney timezone** — `_calIso()` used `toISOString()` (UTC), causing calendar cells to map to the wrong local date for UTC+10/+11 — jobs appeared one day late. Fixed to use local-time getters (`getFullYear/Month/Date`). Same UTC bug fixed in dashboard sidebar schedule widget, budget preset dates, and contacts overdue check. (`web/static/js/schedule.js`, `web/templates/dashboard.html`, `web/static/js/budget.js`, `web/static/js/contacts.js`)
